description: Ordered root-cause rules for host_validation_triage.py. The first rule whose 'when' clauses all match wins (clauses are AND-ed); unmatched jobs are UNKNOWN and emit their signature so this table can be extended. Clause keys: state/terminalState/validationStatus/resultStatus/terminalPassed (exact values, case-insensitive), exceptionClass/message/frame (regex on the first exception block and its caused-by chain), marker (regex on *_RESULT / *_FAILURE / TIMED_OUT / UNAVAILABLE log markers), console (regex on cubism-console.txt ERROR exception heads), failureText (regex on result-properties failure.N, unexpectedFailure actuals, per-assertion actuals and failure-marker log lines). Jobs with no usable evidence at all (reclaimed by retention, or a log that ended before any verdict) are classified NO_EVIDENCE in code, not by a rule here. FREE-license startup markers (START_FREE_SELECTED, FREE_PARAMETER_LIMIT_ACKNOWLEDGED, FREE_WELCOME_CONFIRMED) are emitted by the NativeStartupAssistanceAgent on every installation and are never treated as failure evidence.

rules.advice: verdict recorded; no action

when.message: verification record fields do not match the reviewed manifest|record selectors do not match the runtime-owned manifest

rules.advice: verification records are out of sync with the reviewed manifest; fix the records and re-run offline precheck instead of retrying

when.message: Verified Cubism Core runtime admission failed|EVIDENCE_REJECTED|VERSION_MISMATCH|host admission failed before plugin loading

rules.advice: host admission rejected verified evidence; refresh the verification records, do not blind-retry

rules.advice: capability not exposed on this host/profile; record the boundary

probe reported the capability UNAVAILABLE; record the boundary

when.failureText: backupNow failed|auto-backup completion timeout|auto-backup backup directory is unavailable

rules.advice: native auto-backup produced no artifact and never advanced lastAutoBackupTime inside the poll window on this host/profile (AutoBackupCoordinator completion-timeout throw site, ~runtime/.../AutoBackupCoordinator.java:445-555). The probe exercised the host's own backupNow() the same way it does on passing versions, so the absence is a host-side capability boundary on this version/license profile, not a probe defect — record the boundary instead of retrying

rules.advice: EDT did not accept dispatch within the bound; transient host scheduling pressure, retry is appropriate

rules.advice: model did not become ready inside the observation window; transient load, retry

when.message: timed out before host execution|MCP startup failed

rules.advice: host-side execution timed out; retry under lower host load
